components.name: .Carousel/Dot
components.description: Carousel pagination dot. State = Active | Inactive × Variant = Default | On media = 4 variants. Active is a pill (size/carousel-dot/active), inactive a circle (size/status-dot/1). Use Variant=On media when dots sit over an image.

components.name: .Carousel/Thumb
components.description: Gallery thumbnail for Carousel. State = Default | Hover | Active × Size = S (size/field/3) | M (size/field/4) = 6 variants. Replace the Image layer fill with a product photo. Default has no border (GEN-02). Hover = 2 px neutral/strong ring, Active = 2 px accent ring — state indicators only.

components.name: .Carousel/Indicator
components.description: Carousel position indicator. Type = Dots | Fraction | Progress | Thumbnails; Thumbnails also has Orientation = Horizontal | Vertical (5 variants). Show item 4/5 toggles the count; Fraction text is editable. Nest inside Carousel; swap nested Dot Variant to On media over images.

components.name: Carousel
components.description: Content carousel. Controls = Arrows | Dots only | None × Placement = Inside | Below = 6 variants. Slide is an INSTANCE_SWAP (default _Slot) — swap it for any content — image, card, testimonial, onboarding step; Show peek reveals the next slide (mobile). Arrows are Raised icon Buttons; Indicator is an exposed .Carousel/Indicator (switch Type to Fraction / Progress / Thumbnails). Inside dots use Var
